sources.name: Uzņēmumu reģistrs (Register of Enterprises)
sources.verdict: Verified live. National commercial register; homepage offers 'Receive Automated Data for Systems' — API services and open data sets; e-services at registrs.ur.gov.lv.

sources.name: UR information portal (info.ur.gov.lv)
sources.verdict: Linked from UR homepage as the free data-search portal for register records. Link verified from UR site; portal itself is an Angular SPA, not deep-fetched.

sources.name: UR open data on data.gov.lv (bulk)
sources.verdict: Verified: 30 datasets, CSV (all) + JSON (21), CC0 1.0, updated daily — includes register entities, AS shareholders, sanctions-risk info, reorganizations, interest representatives. This is the primary $0 bulk route for Latvian entities.

sources.name: Latvia Open Data Portal (data.gov.lv)
sources.verdict: Verified working (org and dataset-search pages fetched). Standard CKAN portal, so CKAN JSON API available; hosts UR, insolvency, MKD, IUB procurement and other datasets.

sources.name: Latvijas Banka — financial market participant register
sources.verdict: Verified. Central bank (absorbed FKTK 2023) register with 14 segments: investment management companies, ALTERNATIVE INVESTMENT FUND MANAGERS, credit institutions, insurers, investment service providers, pension funds, crypto-asset markets (MiCA), payment institutions, crowdfunding providers, currency traders. Per-segment filtered lists; no export button seen — HTML parseable. Old uzraudziba.bank.lv URLs 301 here.

sources.name: Latvijas Banka statistical database (statdb)
sources.verdict: Linked from bank.lv homepage as the statistics DB (investment funds, pension plans, MFI data); PxWeb-style DBs normally have an API but I did not fetch it directly — verify API route in build.

sources.name: SPRK — Public Utilities Commission
sources.verdict: Verified regulator for energy, telecom, water, waste — relevant for Real Assets/Infrastructure operators. Registration data lives in its SIPI system; public export of licensee lists not confirmed in fetch.

sources.name: PTAC — Consumer Rights Protection Centre (non-bank lender & debt-collector licences)
sources.verdict: Verified agency. PTAC licenses non-bank consumer creditors and debt-recovery (collection) companies — key for Private Debt & Credit entity sourcing — but the register page was not located in the fetch (guessed URL 404). Needs manual locate of 'licencētie tirgus dalībnieki' pages.

sources.name: Latvijas Vēstnesis (official gazette)
sources.verdict: Verified: official publication of the Republic of Latvia, archive to 1993, advanced search by document type/publisher/date; publishes court notices, inheritance, auctions, insolvency announcements. Footer references a /feed/JL feed — rssUrl recorded but feed content not fetched (verify).

sources.name: Maksātnespējas procesi — insolvency proceedings open dataset
sources.verdict: Verified: 'Maksātnespējas procesi' dataset by UR, CSV/XLSX, CC0, updated DAILY (last update 2026-08-03). The open insolvency register the hint promised — genuinely open. Plus MKD's employee-claims dataset (annual).

sources.name: Maksātnespējas reģistrs (insolvency register web UI)
sources.verdict: Fetch returned empty page (JS app). The register exists (referenced by MKD and UR); use the daily open-data CSV route above instead.

sources.name: MKD — Insolvency Control Service
sources.verdict: Verified state authority under Ministry of Justice supervising insolvency administrators. Administrator roll page not found at guessed URL (404); administrators also appear in the Insolvency Register data. Publishes employee-claims open data on data.gov.lv.

sources.name: Latvian courts portal (tiesas.lv)
sources.verdict: Verified Courts Administration portal — court directory, judges lists; case/ruling e-services delegated to elieta.lv.

sources.name: eLieta — court e-case portal
sources.verdict: Referenced from tiesas.lv as the online portal for proceedings and rulings; not directly fetched — access model (auth vs public anonymized rulings) to be confirmed.

sources.name: Zemesgrāmata — State Unified Land Register
sources.verdict: Verified: court-run land register with public property search (no login) by cadastral data — ownership trail for real-asset entities.

sources.name: Kadastrs.lv — State Land Service cadastre
sources.verdict: Verified VZD portal; cadastral valuations and e-services; some services require authentication.

sources.name: Nasdaq Baltic — share/issuer lists
sources.verdict: Verified: Baltic Main (32), Secondary (17), First North (18+1) lists with Riga home-market filter and XLSX download.

sources.name: LVCA — Latvian Private Equity & VC Association
sources.verdict: Verified live and server-rendered (Wix but static content readable) — '40 Active Members'. Members nav link currently mispoints to a privacy-policy slug; member roster needs a crawl of site subpages, retry as hinted.

sources.name: Finance Latvia Association
sources.verdict: Verified: 11 full members (Swedbank, SEB, Luminor, Citadele...) + 22 associate members (leasing, payments, pension managers) shown as homepage logos; publishes lending/deposit statistics. /en/members/ path 404s — parse homepage.

sources.name: LAA — Latvian Insurers Association
sources.verdict: Verified: 15 members (10 non-life, 5 life, ~99.7% of market), 'Biedri' member section and 'Tirgus dati' market statistics.

sources.name: Altum — state development finance institution
sources.verdict: Verified: fund-of-funds/LP programs listed — Venture Capital & PE, IPO Fund, Altum Capital Fund, Three Seas Initiative Investment Fund — plus news section. Key anchor LP for the Latvian GP map.

sources.name: LIAA — Investment and Development Agency of Latvia
sources.verdict: Verified: news at /en/articles, RSS subscription offered (feed URL not captured), incubator/sector info, FDI facilitation.

sources.name: Possessor — public asset manager / privatization agency
sources.verdict: Verified (note: https 301s to http): active auctions with prices/dates, state capital-share sales, problem-asset management — distressed/special-situations signal source.

sources.name: EIS — Electronic Procurement System
sources.verdict: Verified: public tender finder with CPV, authority, status and deadline filters; e-auctions/e-orders subsystems.

sources.name: IUB — Procurement Monitoring Bureau (open data)
sources.verdict: Verified: publishes procurement notices, statistics and classifiers as machine-readable open data plus a notice search — the bulk route for LV procurement (infra/EPC contractor discovery).

sources.name: LZRA — sworn auditors registers
sources.verdict: Verified: four public registers — sworn auditors, audit firms, third-country auditors and firms — under 'Revidentu reģistri'.

sources.name: Latvian Council of Sworn Advocates (advokatura.lv)
sources.verdict: Real body (bar association with advocate roll) but site returned HTTP 403 to our fetcher — needs browser-grade crawling or manual verification.

sources.name: Latvian Sworn Notaries (DigiNotārs)
sources.verdict: Verified: platform of the Council of Sworn Notaries with 'find a notary on the map' directory. /en path 404s — use root.

sources.name: LANĪDA — Latvian Real Estate Association
sources.verdict: Verified: member directory (legal entities + individuals) and certified real-estate agent lists — brokerage/property-management layer for Real Assets.

sources.name: BIS — Construction Information System registers
sources.verdict: Verified: public registers of construction companies, building specialists, inspectors, residential property managers, energy auditors — EPC/developer/property-manager discovery.

sources.name: VID — State Revenue Service public databases
sources.verdict: Verified: taxpayer rating system and SRS public database advertised on homepage; tax-debtor data historically also on data.gov.lv.

sources.name: Central Statistical Bureau (stat.gov.lv)
sources.verdict: Verified: PxWeb database at data.stat.gov.lv plus an explicit 'API and code list registry' — macro/sector context data.

sources.name: Startin.LV — Latvian Startup Association + startup database
sources.verdict: Verified: 100+ members, public startup database at startups.startin.lv, Latvian Startup Report 2025 — VC pipeline mapping.

sources.name: LTRK — Latvian Chamber of Commerce and Industry
sources.verdict: Verified org (8,000+ members, largest business organization) but a public member directory was not visible on the fetched page — directory route unconfirmed.

sources.name: LVĢMC — Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (EU ETS national administrator)
sources.verdict: Site fetched but rendered nearly empty (JS app), so its ETS Union-Registry national-administrator role and any account lists could NOT be confirmed from the page. Treat as the lead for LV ETS accounts; EU-level EUTL transaction data is the reliable fallback.

sources.name: Likumi.lv — legislation portal
sources.verdict: Verified: official legal-acts systematization site (run by Latvijas Vēstnesis) with RSS feeds per legal-act category (laws, Cabinet regulations, court decisions). Individual feed URLs not captured — pick from site.

sources.name: Dienas Bizness (db.lv)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED: RSS 2.0 with ~50 items of Latvian corporate/investment news (airBaltic bonds, factory investments). Latvia's main business daily. Paywalled articles, headlines free.

sources.name: Delfi Bizness
sources.verdict: Largest LV news portal's business section — real and active, but delfi.lv is entirely unfetchable by our crawler (hard block), so the historical RSS route (delfi.lv/rss/?channel=bizness) could not be verified. Needs browser-grade fetch or partnership.

sources.name: LSM.lv — Latvian public broadcaster (incl. eng.lsm.lv)
sources.verdict: RSS index exists at /rss/ (and eng.lsm.lv/rss/) but both returned HTTP 403 to our fetcher — feeds are real but bot-gated; verify with proper user-agent. Strong free economy desk in LV and EN.

sources.name: BNN — Baltic News Network (LV)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED (WordPress, updated within a day). General + business Baltic coverage.

sources.name: BNN — Baltic News Network (EN)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED: English-language Baltic coverage, hourly updates.

sources.name: TVNET
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED, but general-news mix with thin dedicated business content; useful as secondary signal only. Section-specific feeds may exist (Postimees Group pattern).

sources.name: Diena
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING FEED: single mixed channel including 'Uzņēmēja diena' business items (airBaltic bondholders, AST grid projects).

sources.name: The Baltic Times
sources.verdict: Verified: English monthly covering EE/LV/LT politics, economy, business. No RSS feed visible — HTML parsing needed.

sources.name: Ir (ir.lv / Ir Nauda)
sources.verdict: Verified: quality weekly with dedicated 'Ir Nauda' money/business strand. Freemium paywall (3 free articles), no RSS seen.

sources.name: Labs of Latvia
sources.verdict: The national startup-ecosystem media outlet — real and active, but the site (and /feed) rendered only a title to our fetcher (JS SPA). Needs headless crawl; feed existence unconfirmed.

sources.name: Latvijas Banka — news and articles
sources.verdict: Verified section (linked from homepage): licensing decisions, supervisory announcements, macro releases — primary-source signals for fund-manager licensing events.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance news
sources.verdict: Verified: news at /en/articles (EBRD cooperation, state-aid topics). No RSS visible.

sources.name: Nasdaq Baltic market news (issuer disclosures)
sources.verdict: Verified: official issuer announcements with a 'Riga market' checkbox filter and full archive. No RSS link on page (GlobeNewswire carries these feeds — unverified).

sources.name: ArcticStartup
sources.verdict: Real Nordic-Baltic startup outlet covering Latvian rounds, but /feed/ returned HTTP 403 to our fetcher — bot-gated; feed likely exists (WordPress).

sources.name: Forbes Baltics
sources.verdict: Real licensed Forbes edition covering the Baltics incl. Latvian finance, but DNS resolution timed out during verification — URL unconfirmed from this environment; re-check.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Thin but present Baltic coverage: the handful of institutional-grade LV GPs (BaltCap, INVL, Livonia Partners, FlyCap, Expansion Capital) and Altum as LP/fund-of-funds; fund closes and mandates, little below the top tier.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Latvijas Banka AIFM/ManCo register (licensing events), LVCA membership and yearbook, Altum program announcements, fund press releases — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Baltic VC/PE deal coverage is decent for rounds with press; company financials for LV are weak. Strong on cross-border acquirers of Latvian targets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Nasdaq Baltic issuer disclosures, press releases, Delfi/DB business press, UR registry data via re-users — we can go to UR open data and Nasdaq Baltic news directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best-in-class Latvian startup/VC graph — works with national ecosystems; Latvian startup counts, rounds, investor mapping.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startin.LV startup database and Latvian Startup Report, LIAA/Labs of Latvia ecosystem reporting, self-reported profiles — startups.startin.lv and LIAA are directly public.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Self-reported Latvian startup profiles and funding rounds; patchy amounts, stale after seed stage.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company self-submissions plus tech press (ArcticStartup, Labs of Latvia) — the underlying press is public.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: THE local incumbent: full LV company data, annual reports, pledges, insolvency, media monitoring, beneficial-owner and litigation flags. Site 403s to bots (paid product). Not to be scraped — but its existence proves the deterministic build path.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Licensed re-user of Uzņēmumu reģistrs, Insolvency Register, Commercial Pledge Register, court data, Latvijas Vēstnesis — every one of which we catalogued as a direct public source.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Verified local provider: consolidated legal/factual company DB, industry search, monitoring, micro-payment access. Explicitly labels itself a UR data re-user.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Uzņēmumu reģistrs/Commercial Register, Insolvency Register, Commercial Pledges Register, Land Registry, CSDD vehicle data — all public routes we hold.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit-risk profiles, payment-behavior scores and debtor lists on LV companies (not verified by fetch this session; long-standing provider).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: UR registry, VID tax-debtor publications, insolvency register, court/gazette announcements — direct public equivalents catalogued above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: National news agency with paid sector-news service (Nozare.lv) — the deepest paid LV business-news layer; excluded from our source list because it is subscription-only.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Own reporting plus gazette/registry monitoring; the free public layer (Latvijas Vēstnesis, UR open data, ministry press) is what we ingest directly.

searchedButAbsent: Method note: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so discovery ran on domain knowledge + direct URL verification via fetch; every listed source was fetched, and fetch failures are marked honestly in verdicts. Searched/checked but absent or unconfirmed: (1) LVCA member roster page — association verified live but the members nav link mispoints (Wix); roster needs a crawl retry. (2) manapensija.lv statistics — the /en/statistics page is 404; 2nd-pillar plan/manager stats now live in Latvijas Banka's statdb instead. (3) Fintech Latvia Association — fintechlatvia.eu now 301-redirects to bank.lv's fintech-services page; the association appears to have no independent web presence anymore. (4) No Latvia-specific RICS directory — RICS firms are only searchable via global ricsfirms.com (not verified); the national valuer body (LĪVA, Latvian Association of Property Appraisers) could not be URL-verified this session. (5) No dedicated fund-administrator licensee list — fund administration falls under Latvijas Banka's ManCo/AIFM segments. (6) No separate NPL-servicer register — debt-recovery firms are licensed by PTAC, whose register page could not be located by fetch (agency verified). (7) LVĢMC's EU ETS national-administrator role could not be confirmed on its JS-only site; EUTL at EU level is the fallback for LV ETS accounts. (8) Insolvency-administrator roll at MKD — guessed URLs 404; administrators are surfaced via the Insolvency Register data instead. (9) Bot-blocked (403/JS) but real: advokatura.lv, lursoft.lv, lsm.lv RSS, arcticstartup.com feed, labsoflatvia.com, maksatnespeja.ur.gov.lv, delfi.lv (whole domain), forbesbaltics.com (DNS timeout). (10) No public UBO bulk data — EU-wide public access restriction (expected; project rule already assumes this). No padding was used: 52 catalogued sources are all real and individually checked.
